title: Couples Discount
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, characters engage in humorous plans to pretend to be couples for discounts, while personal relationships and office events unfold, including a breakup and a warehouse fire incident.

main_threads.thread: Characters plan to pretend to be couples for discounts and navigate personal relationships, including Erin and Andy, and Jim and Pam, amidst office chaos and a warehouse fire.
